title: Mobility Data GTFS PMTiles
description: A global PMTiles vector tile file derived from all active GTFS (General Transit Feed Specification) feeds in the Mobility Database Catalog, maintained by Mobility Data. It consolidates public transit network data—stops, routes, and shapes—from transit agencies worldwide into a single tileset. The dataset is described as a work in progress with planned updates.

## README.md
# Mobility Data GTFS PMTiles

A single PMTiles file created from all active GTFS data from Mobility Database Catalog from Mobility Data. 

This is a work in progress. Data will be updated. 

## Demo
https://protomaps.github.io/PMTiles/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdata.source.coop%2Fsmartmaps%2Fmobility-gtfs-pmtiles%2Fmobility.pmtiles

## Specifications
Downloading and conversion script is at https://github.com/optgeo/mmx-gtfs. 

## See also
- https://mobilitydatabase.org/
